decisions.reason: Reframing the Page 74 photo does not change the one-page cover-letter format, signature insertion, or handling of the letter's overflow photos.
The source requests a localized photo crop and does not alter the full-document layout approach, coverage, pass count, or spacing.
Page 74 photo framing is unrelated to the background treatment for the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, and last page.
The photo-framing change does not affect font consistency, font size, or the unresolved bolding instructions.
Reframing one photograph does not change the Blue Mesa Strategies identity, logo, colors, or branding scope.
The Page 74 photograph instruction does not change organization-chart inclusion or placement.
The requested photo crop does not change Canva editing access, file ownership, link delivery, or asset policy.
The source does not change the maximum page count or spacing policy; it only changes framing within an existing photo.
Photo reframing has no entailed effect on whether hyperlinks remain functional in the final PDF.
The Page 74 photo crop does not affect biography count, affiliation, source, or population method.
The source does not alter the budget sheet, supplied tables, revised-table replacements, or table source.
Reframing a photograph does not change the required PDF format, print readiness, email submission, compatibility, or export quality.
